description: What an integration must keep out of a session whose memory mode is `off`. `marker` is a drawer seeded into the palace, whose `token` must reach the model of a `full` or `read-only` session through wake-up, and of no `off` session through any path in `paths`. Each path is one way an integration could hand MemCastle-derived material to the model; `applies_to` names the integrations that have it. Every integration test replays this file, and fails when a path is added here and not driven there.

items.name: decisions/isolation
items.content: offisolationmarkertoken the palace remembers this, and an off session must never hear it

off_rules.description: An off session makes no HTTP or MCP request at all: not a health check, not a handshake, not a rejected call. The daemon would refuse the reads, but a client that already knows the mode must not ask.

paths.description: The wake-up briefing added to the model's context at the first (Pi) or every (OpenCode) model request.
A command that prints the briefing. It must say MemCastle is not active, and quote nothing.
The instruction to search first, added to the system prompt. It names MemCastle tools the session does not have.
The review every N exchanges, which asks a model about the conversation and writes to MemCastle.
The on-demand checkpoint: Pi's slash command, OpenCode's tool.
The last checkpoint before the host summarises the conversation.
The shared skills offered to the host's own skill mechanism.
Any tool or slash command the integration registers with the host for the model or the user to call.
